mapper.insert: WITH target AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT provider.id AS provider_id, account.id AS account_id FROM iam_identity_provider provider JOIN iam_account account ON account.id = #{identity.accountId} AND account.scope_type = provider.scope_type AND account.scope_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM provider.scope_id AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.deleted = 0 JOIN iam_subject subject ON subject.id = account.subject_id AND subject.status = 'ACTIVE' AND subject.deleted = 0 WHERE provider.id = #{identity.providerId} AND provider.status = 'ACTIVE' AND provider.deleted = 0 FOR SHARE OF provider, account, subject ) INSERT INTO iam_external_identity ( id, provider_id, account_id, external_subject, display_name, email, email_verified, avatar_uri, last_authenticated_at, version, deleted ) SELECT #{identity.id}, target.provider_id, target.account_id, #{identity.externalSubject}, #{identity.displayName}, #{identity.email}, #{identity.emailVerified}, #{identity.avatarUri}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, 0 FROM target
mapper.update: WITH target AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT external_identity.id FROM iam_external_identity external_identity JOIN iam_identity_provider provider ON provider.id = external_identity.provider_id AND provider.status = 'ACTIVE' AND provider.deleted = 0 JOIN iam_account account ON account.id = external_identity.account_id AND account.scope_type = provider.scope_type AND account.scope_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM provider.scope_id AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' AND account.deleted = 0 JOIN iam_subject subject ON subject.id = account.subject_id AND subject.status = 'ACTIVE' AND subject.deleted = 0 WHERE external_identity.id = #{identityId} AND external_identity.provider_id = #{providerId} AND external_identity.version = #{version} AND external_identity.deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE OF external_identity FOR SHARE OF provider, account, subject ) UPDATE iam_external_identity SET display_name = #{profile.displayName}, email = #{profile.email}, email_verified = #{profile.emailVerified}, avatar_uri = #{profile.avatarUri}, last_authenticated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM target)
mapper.select: SELECT external_identity.id AS identity_id, external_identity.provider_id, external_identity.account_id, external_identity.external_subject, external_identity.display_name AS external_display_name, external_identity.email, external_identity.email_verified, external_identity.avatar_uri, external_identity.last_authenticated_at, external_identity.version AS identity_version, provider.code AS provider_code, provider.name AS provider_name, provider.protocol AS provider_protocol, provider.status AS provider_status FROM iam_external_identity external_identity JOIN iam_identity_provider provider ON provider.id = external_identity.provider_id AND provider.deleted = 0 WHERE external_identity.account_id = #{accountId} AND external_identity.deleted = 0 ORDER BY provider.code, external_identity.id

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_external_identity external_identity JOIN iam_identity_provider provider ON provider.id = external_identity.provider_id AND provider.status = 'ACTIVE' AND provider.deleted = 0 WHERE external_identity.account_id = #{accountId} AND external_identity.id != #{excludedIdentityId} AND external_identity.deleted = 0 )
